compiler.jvm_target_scope: Official target JVM1.8; candidate emits supported classfile versions without a target-selection option.

metadata_flags_oracle.api: JvmProtoBufUtil.readClassDataFrom + Flags.HAS_ANNOTATIONS; exact Annotated class/plus/primary value/getter/setter/setter-parameter selection. Omitted accessor flags inherit property HAS_ANNOTATIONS/visibility/modality per pinned metadata.proto and MemberDeserializer. Selected effective numeric flags and HAS bits are checked, including setter IS_NOT_DEFAULT.

annotation_dependency_provenance.extraction: Unchanged classes.jar from the real AAR; only annotation declaration resolution tested, no Compose plugin transformation.

inputs.external_compilation: javac builds all Java annotation dependencies; pinned official Kotlin builds only PropertyMark annotation dependency. All positive production source files are candidate-owned.
inputs.ordinary_annotation_scope: Existing Java annotation classes with String/Int/Boolean constants. Property/type-use targets and array/class/enum constants are explicit unsupported boundaries.
inputs.friend_entrypoint_scope: One fixed official-compiled Java launcher invokes FriendKt.main()V for every provider/consumer pair. Original friend assertions and compiler flags are unchanged; automatic Kotlin main(String[]) bridge lowering is outside scope.
